question: The disease xerodermia pigmentosa is related to defects in the mechanism of DNA repair:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Xeroderma pigmentosum -> Defects in DNA repair mechanism -> Impaired ability to repair DNA damage -> Increased risk of skin cancer -> 90% confidence. CHAIN: Xeroderma pigmentosum -> Defect in nucleotide excision repair pathway -> Inability to remove UV-induced DNA damage -> Accumulation of mutations -> 90%
analysis: Xeroderma pigmentosum is a genetic disorder characterized by an inability to repair DNA damage caused by ultraviolet (UV) light. This defect in DNA repair mechanisms leads to an increased risk of skin cancer and other skin abnormalities.
